# Map of the Code {#sec-codebook}

This chapter points to where each step of the method lives and how to run it. It does not reproduce the code, which changes faster than the book; read the files themselves for the current version. Paths are relative to the repository root.

## Where each step lives

All functions below are in `simulations/src/R/dpmm_fit.R` unless noted. The psusize design has its own copy, `simulations/psusize_design/src/R/dpmm_fit.R`, which has diverged (see below).

| Step | Function | Chapter |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Rescale weights | `scale_weights` | @sec-weights |
| Gibbs sampler | `fit_wdpmm` | @sec-gibbs |
| Exact MH sampler | `fit_wdpmm_mh` | @sec-gibbs |
| Exact HMC sampler | `simulations/src/R/hmc_fit.R`, `simulations/src/stan/pi_w.stan` | @sec-gibbs |
| FOLD merge | `fold_partition`, `fold_hellinger_draws`, `fold_delta_cpp` | @sec-phenotypes |
| Map draws to phenotypes; prevalences | `summarize_phenotypes` | @sec-phenotypes |
| Scores and Hessian | `unit_scores`, `sandwich_core` | @sec-score-hessian |
| Between-PSU meat; standard errors and flags | `jackknife_sandwich_cpp`, `godambe_sandwich` | @sec-jackknife |
| One replicate end to end | `run_one_sample`, `run_and_save_sample` | — |
| Summaries across replicates | `simulations/src/R/summarize.R` | @sec-simulations |

C++ helpers are in `simulations/src/cpp/dpmm_helpers.cpp`: `sample_z_cpp` (allocations), `sparse_dirichlet_weights_cpp` (component weights), `jackknife_sandwich_cpp` (meat) and `fold_delta_cpp` (FOLD distances). They are compiled with Rcpp when `dpmm_fit.R` is sourced.

## Options

`dpmm_fit.R` is configured by environment variables, read once at the top. Each value other than the default adds a suffix to the result tag, so different settings never overwrite each other.

| Option | Values (default first) | Meaning |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `POP_SCENARIO` | base, rare, skew, overlap | Population |
| `N_PSU` | 4 (main), 2 (psusize) | PSUs per stratum |
| `MERGE` | fold_unweighted, fold | Merge rule (the code's default is still an earlier rule; always set `MERGE` explicitly) |
| `FOLD_CUT` | gap, avg | FOLD cut (psusize copy only) |
| `SAMPLER` | gibbs, mh | Sampler |
| `WEIGHT_SUM` | neff, n, one | Weight total |
| `ALPHA0`, `L`, `KAPPA0` | 0.001, 10, 0.5 | Prior settings |
| `CHAIN` | 1 | Chain number; changes the seed |
| `OUT_TAG` | — | Replaces the result tag (smoke tests) |

## How the two copies differ

The psusize copy was taken on 10 November 2026 and has changed since. The main copy does not follow its changes.

| | Main `dpmm_fit.R` | psusize copy |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| FOLD cut | Elbow | Height gap, or $\gamma_{\text{AVG}}$ with `FOLD_CUT=avg` |
| $\hat K \neq 4$ | Replicate dropped | Kept: results at every $\hat K$ in `level` |

## Running a simulation

Everything heavy runs through SLURM, never on the login node. From `simulations/psusize_design/`:

```bash
# Smoke test: replicate 1 only (reused by the full array)
sbatch -p general --array=1 --mem=2G \
  --export=ALL,CHUNK=1,MERGE=fold_unweighted,POP_SCENARIO=overlap run_fit.sbatch

# Full arm: 40 tasks of 25 replicates, about an hour each
sbatch -p general --array=1-40 --mem=2G \
  --export=ALL,CHUNK=25,MERGE=fold_unweighted,POP_SCENARIO=overlap,REP_TIMEOUT=30m run_fit.sbatch
```

Each task runs its replicates in turn, skips any already saved, and logs one line per replicate (`[done]`, `[skipped]` or `[failed]`). Results go to `results/result_<tag>_<NNNN>.rds`; larger posterior objects to `posteriors_<tag>/`.

To summarise an arm:

```bash
Rscript src/R/summarize.R <tag>       # per-phenotype table, all replicates
Rscript checks/check_arm.R <tag>      # replicates with K_hat = 4 and an unflagged SE
Rscript checks/check_levels.R <tag>   # every replicate, scored at the K_hat it reports
```

(Run these inside `srun` or `sbatch` on Longleaf.)

## NHANES

`nhanes/fit_nhanes.R` fits the same pipeline to NHANES 1999–2004 (one chain per call, $L = 20$). It takes the function definitions from the main `dpmm_fit.R` (not the psusize copy), so it follows the main copy. `nhanes/run_fold_reuse.sbatch` re-summarises saved fits with FOLD without refitting.
